title: HJR B (2025-2026 Regular Session, Michigan Legislature (bill page title: "House Joint Resolution B of 2025")): Elections: registration; verification of an elector's United States citizenship; require, and modify voter identification requirements. Amends secs. 1 & 4, art. II of the state constitution.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) (g) The right, once registered, and, for an individual described in section 1(2) of this article, once United States citizenship is verified as provided in section 1(2) of this article, to prove their identity when voting in person or applying for an absent voter ballot in person by (1) presenting their photo identification, including photo identification issued by a federal, state, local, or tribal government or an educational institution, or, (2) if they do not have photo identification or do not have it with them, executing an affidavit verifying their identity.
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) The legislature shall define identification for election purposes, and that definition must include only types of identification issued by a federal, state, local, or tribal government or an educational institution.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) (g) The right, once registered, and, for an individual described in section 1(2) of this article, once United States citizenship is verified as provided in section 1(2) of this article, to prove their identity when voting in person or applying for an absent voter ballot in person by (1) presenting their photo identification, including photo identification issued by a federal, state, local, or tribal government or an educational institution, or, (2) if they do not have photo identification or do not have it with them, executing an affidavit verifying their identity.
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) A voter shall be required to vote a provisional ballot if they executed an affidavit to prove their identity.
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) The provisional ballot must be tabulated only if the individual presents photo identification, including photo identification issued by a federal, state, local, or tribal government or an educational institution, on or before the sixth day after the election.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) Voters shall have the right to prove their identity when applying for or voting an absent voter ballot other than in person by providing their signature, along with providing an original or a copy of an identification for election purposes, or providing the individual's driver license number, official state personal identification card number, or the last four digits of the individual's Social Security number, to the election official authorized to issue absent voter ballots.
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) In addition, the election officials shall verify the elector's identification for election purposes, or the elector's driver license number, official state personal identification card number, or the last four digits of the elector's Social Security number, provided by the elector.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) unnumbered text (as in the version read)
(quote) (2) For an individual registering to vote after December 18, 2026, to be an elector who is qualified to vote in any election and who has the rights provided in section 4 of this article, the individual's United States citizenship must be verified by either of the following methods:
(section) unnumbered text (as in the version read)
(quote) (a) The individual presenting documentary proof of United States citizenship, either at the time the individual registers to vote with the election official or designated voter registration agency authorized by law to receive voter registrations or at a later date, to the secretary of state or to the county, city, or township clerk of the county, city, or township in which the individual resides.
(section) unnumbered text (as in the version read)
(quote) (b) The secretary of state verifying that the individual is a United States citizen.
(section) unnumbered text (as in the version read)
(quote) (7) Documentary proof of United States citizenship includes only types of documentation that establish an individual's United States citizenship.
(section) Sec. 4 (as in the version read)
(quote) For an individual described in section 1(2) of this article, the individual's United States citizenship must be verified as provided in section 1(2) of this article before the individual may vote a regular ballot or an absent voter ballot that is not treated as a provisional ballot at an election.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Only the section(s) quoted above are amended; no other subject.
(note) The only floor vote (House, 2025-05-01, not adopted 58-48) was on House substitute H-1, whose text is not in the store: that vote is not a record on this text and cannot seat. Co-sponsors are coded on the text above (as filed).
